title: Paper Plate Detective
objective: Describe the observable properties of a paper plate and choose its safe use or handling.

items.explanation: Rubber band bends easily, so it is flexible.
Cotton towel soaks up water, so it absorbs water.
Metal fork is firm and does not bend, so it is hard.

items.prompt: What property does a paper plate have?
items.explanation: A paper plate is light and flimsy, so that is its property.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to learn about a material?

options.text: look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking at it and touching it gently is safe. Tasting, throwing, or hitting materials is not safe.
